ordered_gates.name: Research vessel/readout basis
evidence: Qualified laboratory evidence of the needed vessel class, optical/electrical access, materials and environment; do not infer suitability from a generic flow chamber.

ordered_gates.name: Complete fluid-path compatibility
evidence: Exact syringe, each tubing/connector/SKU and vessel ratings; lowest assembled working limit and protection design; inlet/outlet routing and retained-volume budget.

ordered_gates.name: Adapter and instrument release
evidence: Vendor drawing and measured part against carrier datums; bottom optical clearance, tube bend/strain relief, thermal/readout access, drawings and exact fasteners; preserve existing A0 until explicit revision.

ordered_gates.name: Complete purchase and assembly package
evidence: Every support item identified and priced; delivered quote, consumable packs, fabrication, calibration and labor included; obtain spending approval only for concrete package.

ordered_gates.name: Host control and independent stop
evidence: Observed macOS serial enumeration and real pump identity/readback; configured communications-timeout stop; independent physical stop; no automatic motion after reconnect/power return.

ordered_gates.name: Independent delivery measurement
evidence: Actual balance framing, drift and repeatability; vial/nest plus liquid within capacity; no tubing load; chosen delivery uncertainty and duration supported by measurements.

ordered_gates.name: Physical commissioning and intended-use evidence
evidence: Actual water-only delivery, leak/stop/restart and environmental observations under approved engineering limits; qualified laboratory acceptance for intended use remains separate.
